semantics.alias_rule: fresh F32 output; canonical RGB8 tensor remains immutable
semantics.shape_rule: checked HWC RGB8 image becomes CHW with identical height and width
semantics.dtype_rule: U8 channels become F32 values divided by 255
semantics.layout_rule: delegates the sole canonical HWC-to-CHW traversal and publishes contiguous CHW
semantics.device_rule: CPU ordinal zero on the RGB8 tensor stream; other devices are rejected by the image boundary
semantics.numeric_rule: Torchvision 0.27 ToTensor RGB byte scaling and channel permutation
semantics.tolerance: bit exact F32 division for the source fixture
semantics.determinism: fixed canonical channel, row, and column traversal
semantics.cancellation_points: before image validation, within delegated rows, and before publication
semantics.vjp_rule: non-differentiable U8 image boundary at the cataloged drawing call site
semantics.jvp_rule: non-differentiable U8 image boundary at the cataloged drawing call site
